qa_status: UNVERIFIED - initial source-faithful candidate; Godot 4.5.x engine QA, screenshots and human review required
signature: A harmless, rain-sounding maze of cool sandrooms. Old child-sized impressions and toys persist in thick yellow sand; dying paint, false sunbeams and an impenetrable voidstone roof make the silence feel remembered.

exits.to_label: The originally intended level (not specified on the page)
exits.label: Opened a doorway in a room with no sand
exits.source_quote: will send the wanderer to the level they would have entered originally
exits.hint: Seek a room where the yellow sand does not cover the floor. An ordinary door may lead out.

entity_policy: NONE. Level 75 is explicitly devoid of entities. No NPC, enemies, resources, consumables or hazards are spawned.
notes: SOURCE: sand-filled rooms and corridors, peeling painted blue/cream/rare-red walls, dead lighting fixtures, light beams from arbitrary ceiling/wall spots, phantom rain with no water, a cool dry 15°C interior, immovable voidstone roof, old footprints and toys in inert sand, rooms may take decades to regenerate. ADAPTATION: finite 6×5 seeded spanning-tree maze with occasional short loops, each cell 10×10 m, no regeneration during an expedition; footprints use a bounded 512-instance MultiMesh and thus remain until an actual level reload; the unique sand-free exit room is guaranteed reachable by maze topology, but its destination is intentionally unspecified (EXT release boundary) rather than invented. SOURCE L008>L075#4 supplies an arrival. QA PENDING.
